INTEGRITY COMMISSION
NOTICE
In accordance with Section 28 (4) of the Integrity in Public Life Act No. 24 of 2013, the Integrity
Commission hereby publishes the fact that the following persons in public life have failed to file a declaration
of assets, liabilities, income and interest with the Integrity Commission.
Name Organisation Filing Period
Mr. Kareem Alexis Inland Revenue Division 1st Dec. 2022 - 31st Dec. 2024
Chauffeur Ministry of Finance
Mr. Shane Mc Lawrence Inland Revenue Division 1st Dec. 2022 -31st Dec. 2024
System Administrator Ministry of Finance
The Commission makes reference to Section 28, subsections (4) and (5):
“(4) Where a person in public life, fails to file a declaration in accordance with this section or without
reasonable cause, fails to furnish particulars in accordance with Section 34, the Commission shall publish
such fact in the Gazette and at least one weekly newspaper in circulation in Grenada.”
(5) “The Commission may, at any time, after the publication made pursuant to section (4), make an ex
parte application to the Court for an order directing the person in public life to comply with the provisions
of the Act and the Court may, in addition to making such an order, impose such conditions as it thinks fit.”
The Commission makes reference also to Section 46, subsection (1)(a):
“A person who –
(a) fails without reasonable cause, to furnish to the Commission a declaration or further particulars
which he or she is required to furnish in accordance with the provisions of this Act; …
commits an offence, and is liable, on conviction on indictment, to a fine not exceeding two hundred
thousand dollars or to a term of imprisonment not exceeding five years.”
GILLIAN M. S. BRISTOL
Chairperson,
Integrity Commission of Grenada.
24th March, 2026.

NOTICE FROM THE GRENADA AUTHORITY FOR
THE REGULATION OF FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS (GARFIN)
In accordance with Section 213 of the Insurance Act, Cap. 150 of the 2010 Continuous Revised Edition
of the Laws of Grenada, the public is hereby informed that as of March 20, 2026, the under-mentioned
Insurance Companies, Association of Underwriters, and Insurance Intermediaries (Adjusters, Agents,
Brokers, and Sales Representatives) have been registered to operate in Grenada for the calendar year 2026.
The public is advised that Certificates of Registration are issued to all companies and intermediaries
authorised to conduct business under the Insurance Act. Sections 15 (2) and 91 (3) of the Insurance Act
require all insurance companies and insurance intermediaries to “prominently display its certificate of
registration at its principal place of business in Grenada, in a place to which the public has access, and
a copy of that certificate shall be similarly displayed at each of its branches in Grenada”. In addition,
section 92 states that an insurance intermediary shall produce his/her Certificate of Registration when
requested to do so by any person during business.
The assistance of the public is solicited in bringing to the attention of GARFIN any person or institution
conducting insurance business in Grenada without a valid insurance licence.
